answer: Miscellaneous >> Tasawwuf Question ID: 38780 Country: RE Title: Books on tassawuf Question: What books do you recommend me on Tasawwuf in English and Arabic? Answer ID: 38780 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 975/802/B=1433) We do not know about any book in English on the subject of Tasawwuf. However, there is an Arabic booklet (1) Risala Qushairiyah by Imam Qushairi, it is very nice book. Hadhrat Imam Ghazali (رحمة الله) has authored a number of books in Arabic. You may learn about them in his biography under the category of his works. You may study any below mentioned book which you find, they are useful and effective books: (2) Ahyaul Uloom, (3) Baqiyatul Qasidin, (4) Minhajuddin by Imam Ghazali, (5) Madarij al-Salikin by Ibn Qayyim al-Jauzi, (6) al-Fath al-Rabbani, (7) Kitab al-Ghuniya by Shaikh Abdul Qadir Geelani, (8) Tanbihul Muftarin by Abdul Wahab Sharani, (9) Nuzha al-Nazirin by Shaikh Taqiuddin, (10) Tabaqat by Shah Ismail Shahid, (11) Al-Insan al-Kamil by Ibn Arabi, (12) Al-Insan al-Kamil Fi Marifah al-Awael Wal Awakhir by Sayyid Abdul Kareem Ibn Ibrahim, (13) Al-Yawaqit Wal-Jawahar by Abdul Wahab ibn Ahmad ibn Ali and (14) Ithaf Al-Sadah al-Muttaqin by Allama Sayyid Muhammad Ibn Muhammad al-Hussaini al-Zubaidi. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
